sources: Al Jazeera liveblog, citing medical staff + AJ correspondent Ashraf Abu Amra on the ground
fault_line: Ceasefire or cover? One more strike on a displacement camp's tents -- a Yellow Line enforcement action, or proof the truce no longer protects Gaza's displaced?

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] One Palestinian was killed by an Israeli strike targeting the Halawa camp, one of the largest displacement camps in northern Gaza, east of Jabalia, medical staff reported. AJ's correspondent reports attacks escalating on the camp, with Israeli forces stationed along the Yellow Line firing directly at tents sheltering displaced families. Separately in the same entry: Israeli warplanes struck a house in Gaza City's Saftawi neighbourhood after issuing a warning. No Israeli military comment retrieved in-window.
sections.what_verified: Single declared family: Al Jazeera (T2, STATE-QA) liveblog, citing medical staff and its own correspondent. No second family retrieved in-window; sig-2 item so the 2-family gate does not apply, but the single-casualty figure rests on one family.
sections.what_disputed: No Israeli military statement retrieved in-window. Do NOT attach any since-ceasefire cumulative toll to this item: same-day ministry relays disagree (1,574 vs 1,439 per 1800-04 HOLD; AP carry this evening says 'more than 1,550') -- all three figures are mutually inconsistent and none is settled.
sections.why_matters: Tents under fire on the Yellow Line: one killed at Gaza's Halawa camp as strikes on the camp escalate -- the ceasefire-violation thread, not a toll story
sections.context: Background: NEW IN-WINDOW -- Israeli strike kills one Palestinian at Halawa displacement camp, northern Gaza; attacks on the camp escalating along the Yellow Line
